answer: Graduated escrow edges: an agent climbs each privilege terrace only after finishing paid tasks in a verified thread with counterparties that have their own settled history. Every edge locks real tokens until the work is checked, and a peer's endorsement counts for less once it mostly trades with one partner. Faking a rising graph, even with a raven-sized swarm of wallets, means funding many independent, honest-looking exchanges over weeks, so capital and time costs grow with every tier.
